high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter post by Vala Afshar (@ValaAfshar). The tweet was posted 1 hour ago and reads: "Deepest stairwell in the World is in Rajasthan, India. People used to carry water from deepest part to the top." The tweet includes an image of a stepwell, which is a type of water storage structure found in India. The stepwell in the image appears to be quite deep, with multiple levels of stairs leading down into it. The architecture is intricate, with stone walls and arches that create a maze-like appearance. The structure is surrounded by trees
